speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any specific skin changes like blisters, scaling, or discoloration, and do these symptoms worsen after exposure to heat or stress?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the combination of a pruritic rash on the upper body/face with palm paresthesia in a rice farmer working with livestock is concerning. Given the occupational exposure and your symptoms, have you noticed any small, painless, flesh-colored nodules on your skin or fingers, or any difficulty swallowing or breathing?

REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, ANA, RPR (Syphilis serology), and PPD skin test.
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology_close_up_of_skin_nodules_and_rash.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). The combination of pruritic rash, peripheral neuropathy (numbness/tingling), hypopigmented macules, and loss of eyebrows and eyelashes is pathognomonic for this condition. Immediate referral for slit-skin smear and biopsy is required for confirmation and multidrug therapy initiation.
